description: This file is a shell script for the Git test suite, specifically testing the 'git format-patch' command. It includes various test cases covering different options, edge cases, and output formats for generating patches and emails from git commits.

methods.name: check_patch
methods.description: Verifies that a patch email has the expected header lines, indicating a half-sane patch email format.

methods.name: check_author
methods.description: Checks that the formatted patch has a properly formatted From header with correct quoting and encoding, including tests for RFC2047 encoding when necessary.

methods.name: signature
methods.description: Generates a signature string based on git version, used to verify email footers in patches.

methods.name: append_signoff
methods.description: Appends a Signed-off-by footer to a commit and formats the patch output, then extracts and displays sections related to subject and signoff lines.
